sourceText:
Homemade Enchiritos
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 17, 2009 - 11:23pm

Ingredients




2 pounds Hamburger, (2 to 4)
1 small Jar taco sauce
2 smalls Cans tomato paste
2 pkt Taco seasoning mix
2 cups Water
1 pkt Cheddar or jalapeno
Cheese
1 Onion
1 pkt Flour tortillas

Preparation

1 Brown hamburger and onion; drain. Mix together taco sauce, tomato paste, taco seasoning and water. Pour half the mixture over drained hamburger mixture. Dip onto shells one at a time, wrap up and place in casserole dish. Pour remaining mixture over enchiritos, grate cheese and put on top. 2 Bake until cheese melts. Can be microwaved to melt cheese.
